592:t_1:5.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Don't give me such a scary look. We're not exactly strangers.」

592:t_1:7.en:
$$リディ$$
「The $$西条涼音$$ I know isn't a woman like you.」

592:t_1:8.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「If we're going there, the $$リディ・マーセナス$$ in my memories was a much better man than you.」

592:t_1:10.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Well, let's leave it at that. We've both sided with $$サイデリアル$$.」

592:t_1:11.en:
$$リディ$$
「I have no intention of wagging my tail for them.」

592:t_1:12.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「It's all the same. $$クロノ$$ and $$サイデリアル$$.」

592:t_1:13.en:
$$リディ$$
「Do you know $$クロノ$$'s true doctrine...? The truth that lies even deeper than $$ラプラスの箱$$?」

592:t_1:14.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I have an idea. I'm not a Reactor candidate for nothing.」

592:t_1:15.en:
$$リディ$$
「Is your goal to defeat $n and obtain the $$いがみ合う双子$$ $$スフィア$$?」

592:t_1:16.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I can't leave it to $$バルビエル$$. You should get what you want through your own power, after all.」

592:t_1:19.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I'm after $n, you're after $$バナージ$$... We're both targeting $c.」

592:t_1:20.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I can pinpoint their location using our tracking information and the resonance between $n and me.」

592:t_1:21.en:
$$リディ$$
「...What do you wish for once you obtain the $$スフィア$$?」

592:t_1:22.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Freedom. With power, I can have it.」

592:t_1:23.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「No one will be able to bind me. Yes... Not even the other me.」

592:t_1:26.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「So that's your reason for fighting.」

592:t_1:27.en:
$$リディ$$
「I, like all humanity, can only live within the freedom we're given... That is our destiny...」

592:t_1:31.en: ～ Deep-Space Mothership $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ Bridge ～

592:t_1:33.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「As you know. We've fought across space, time, and parallel worlds.」

592:t_1:34.en:
$$クィーン$$
「Even I don't know what happened after the $$時空震動$$ swallowed you.」

592:t_1:35.en:
$$クィーン$$
「For now, your bold moves on various fronts have disrupted the Empire's battle lines.」

592:t_1:36.en:
$$シャア$$
「The decisive battle is drawing near.」

592:t_1:37.en:
$$クィーン$$
「Of course, the Empire has sensed it, too.」

592:t_1:38.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Our objective is to capture $$ラース・バビロン$$, the heart of the enemy's strategy, and free the people trapped in the $$霊子吸収システム$$.」

592:t_1:39.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「And if we overthrow Emperor $$アウストラリス$$ and defeat his three Reactor lieutenants, we can turn the war completely in Earth's favor.」

592:t_1:40.en:
$$クィーン$$
「Yes. Defeating those four would mean we'd overthrown the Empire.」

592:t_1:41.en:
$$クィーン$$
「But naturally, the Earthlings who submitted to the Empire have begun moving to stop you.」

592:t_1:43.en:
$$オットー$$
「Since both want to be $$サイデリアル$$'s top lackey, it'd be nice if they fought each other, but...」

592:t_1:44.en:
$$クィーン$$
「That probably won't happen. The cunning $$フル・フロンタル$$ in particular intends to profit from the fighting.」

592:t_1:45.en:
$$シャア$$
「He's after $$ラプラスの箱$$ to prove his power.」

592:t_1:46.en:
$$クィーン$$
「Conversely, if you obtain the Box, you'll thwart $$フロンタル$$'s plan.」

592:t_1:47.en:
$$桂$$
「Are you trying to stir up a final battle between us and $$ネオ・ジオン$$?」

592:t_1:48.en:
$$クィーン$$
「You go out of your way to join us here, and then you're so hostile, $$始原の特異点$$.」

592:t_1:49.en:
$$桂$$
「I think you were the one who picked a fight with me first.」

592:t_1:52.en:
$$クィーン$$
「It's all right. What he's saying is true.」

592:t_1:53.en:
$$桂$$
「...But I don't want to stay on bad terms with a woman, either.」

592:t_1:54.en:
$$桂$$
「How about it, $$クィーン$$? Isn't it time you showed us your face?」

592:t_1:55.en:
$$クィーン$$
「That's rather direct for a pickup line.」

592:t_1:56.en:
$$桂$$
「I'm not asking for nothing. ...How about after we defeat the Empire?」

592:t_1:59.en:
$$クィーン$$
「Your positive outlook is your strong point.」

592:t_1:60.en:
$$桂$$
「It isn't just me. It's a strength everyone in $c has.」

592:t_1:61.en:
$$クィーン$$
「I wonder what will happen when you open $$ラプラスの箱$$...」

592:t_1:62.en:
$$シャア$$
「The way you say that... You seem to know the so-called depths of $$ラプラスの箱$$.」

592:t_1:64.en:
$$桂$$
「You call yourself the third $$クロノ$$, but you're still $$クロノ$$.」

592:t_1:65.en:
$$クィーン$$
「The secret of $$ラプラスの箱$$ is indeed $$クロノ$$ doctrine, but only a handful of leaders are told the whole truth.」

592:t_1:66.en:
$$クィーン$$
「In my case, I took advantage of my special position as $$キング$$'s secretary.」

592:t_1:67.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$キング$$... The head of the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives.」

592:t_1:68.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Does your information network use the connections you made while you were in $$クロノ$$?」

592:t_1:69.en:
$$クィーン$$
「I won't deny that. But they're not my only collaborators.」

592:t_1:70.en:
$$クィーン$$
「Many people resent the Empire. Though, to be precise, it isn't the Empire itself...」

592:t_1:71.en:
$$クィーン$$
「One of them has influence even at the heart of the Empire. That person gave the 'spear' to $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$.」

592:t_1:72.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The $$エヴァンゲリオン$$ spear with the power to distort space-time...」

592:t_1:73.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「So $$レナード$$ obtained it from an insider.」

592:t_1:74.en:
$$ブライト$$
「So the Empire isn't a united front.」

592:t_1:75.en:
$$クィーン$$
「Still, all we can do is leak information like this. In the end, we're still counting on you.」

592:t_1:76.en:
$$クィーン$$
「Hehe... I look forward to the day you learn the Box's truth... And the day you challenge the Empire to a decisive battle.」

592:t_1:77.en:
$$クィーン$$
「I'm waiting for the day I can meet you with my face uncovered, too.」

592:t_1:78.en:
$$オットー$$
「She's as willful as ever.」

592:t_1:79.en:
$$桂$$
「Not really. Her heart is on our side...」

592:t_1:80.en:
$$桂$$
「I think she really wouldn't mind showing her face.」

592:t_1:81.en:
$$テッサ$$
「You certainly live up to your reputation as a veteran when it comes to women's hearts.」

592:t_1:82.en:
$$桂$$
「Well, yes. Besides, she's interested in me. Getting her true feelings out isn't that hard.」

592:t_1:83.en:
$$オットー$$
「I don't quite follow, but inviting you here seems to have worked.」

592:t_1:84.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then let's focus first on intercepting the $$クロノ$$ forces coming our way.」

592:t_1:85.en:
$$ブライト$$
「For them, $$ネオ・ジオン$$ obtaining $$ラプラスの箱$$ is something they must avoid at all costs.」
